# Marketing and Chat bot follow-up register · 3 Nov 2026

Branch: `codex/crm-marketing-chat-design`. Changed designs remain **Changed after approval, awaiting founder**. Implements the seven-point brief under the founder instruction to decide and continue, the light-background ruling, and the client-brand exception for the chat widget.

## Result and decisions

1. All **63** active navigation items are visible in the initial desktop screen or mobile drawer specimen, with their group heading visible. The original CRM family `180:8549` now includes desktop `483:39615` and mobile `483:39698` authored scrolled states. Original `180:8387` / `180:8467` IDs remain as Top states. The two scrolled states use the same entries, order, tokens, logo and fonts; they display offsets of 360px / 446px while retaining pinned identity/account blocks. Figma blocks positioning inherited children in instances, so the state is authored in the canonical component family. No parallel menu family or detached screen was introduced.
2. Containers `149:6983`, `149:7468`, `271:3485` remain **560px**. Post and Trigger checks fill 560px, and inner Fields stack within **528px** with their children filling the available width. Horizontal clipping is eliminated; long content continues in the existing vertical scroll area.
3. Compact cards `149:10806` / `149:14873` hug their fields, with **8px gaps**, **16px padding**, and **88px resulting height**. Row IDs `209:6426`, `209:6427`, `209:9704`, `209:9705` remain. Values fit their rows. Calendar post cards `270:3669` / `270:3701` use **8px corners**, **8px padding**, and hug to **88px height**, retaining their prototype links.
4. All Content/* padding values of **40/32 become 24**. Mobile Composer bottom padding **100 becomes 24** on `149:7622`, `149:8004`, `271:3783`; the separate pinned footer remains outside the scrolling content viewport. List heading padding **12 becomes 8**; calendar cell gaps **4 become 8**.
5. No source transitions now use **1.2 seconds**, preserving actions/destinations, on `274:14673`, `274:14699`, `274:24343`, `274:24360`, `274:24377`, `274:24394`, `274:24411`, `274:24428`. The previous value was 1200 seconds. Client widget colours and font bindings are unchanged in this follow-up.
6. Stale layer names now use **Quote draft**, **Settings**, **Confirm · Settings**, **Confirm · Hand-over**. Visible product copy already used those words, and has not changed. Exact before/after layer names appear below.
7. All **10 Disconnect** actions use Secondary `266:3034`, a navy `42:14` outline and navy text on white. Instance root IDs and reactions remain; inherited text IDs follow the Secondary variant. Red remains reserved for Delete.

## ID preservation and evidence

Original screen roots, navigation instance roots, field roots, compact-card roots and action roots remain. Original CRM source roots remain. State/variant swaps necessarily change inherited child IDs; `changes.json` records from/to component IDs and Disconnect child-ID mappings. The edited list includes all IDs directly written by successful batches. The created list includes new canonical state nodes; inherited changes are represented by their component and instance roots.

[Full mutation receipts](changes.json), [full geometry/timing checks](checks.json), [summary](summary.json). Both native Figma registers (`151:3973`, `154:4349`) and their canvas mirrors were updated and read-back verified. Assertions cover 63/63 visible active items, zero stale Content spacing violations, 10/10 secondary Disconnect actions, 8/8 delays at 1.2 seconds, and the requested card/column dimensions. Product fonts are inherited from the approved CRM source (Jost and Inter); the widget brand is untouched. These are authoring checks, not founder approval or production tests.

## New words

**No new product words.** Layer metadata is normalized to the four existing canonical names above. New variant metadata is `Scroll=Top` and `Scroll=Active group`; these words are not product copy. Register prose documents the changes. No production code, deployment, secrets or main-branch changes.
